page_title: CRY 0-0 NOT | Crystal Palace v Nottingham Forest 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
90+3' Willy Boly (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+2' The game is interrupted now, Willy Boly (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
89' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:2.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
86' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Nottingham force their opponents to concede a corner.
84' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) has tested the patience of referee Craig Pawson and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Orel Mangala departs the field of play to be replaced by Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham).
82' A cross from a corner kick by Crystal Palace is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
81' Crystal Palace earn a corner. Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
79' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
78' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
76' Steven Cooper has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Divock Origi (Nottingham) replacing Chris Wood.
76' Substitution. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) in, Ibrahim Sangare out.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is replacing Jairo Riedewald.
74' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
73' Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
71' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
68' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Willy Boly (Nottingham) and blew his whistle.
66' The substitution is prepared. Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Callum Hudson-Odoi.
64' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
62' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Wow, what an escape. Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
57' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
54' Crystal Palace keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
51' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
46' Steven Cooper has made a change at the break. Gonzalo Montiel has come on in place of Serge Aurier (Nottingham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Murillo (Nottingham) unleashes a promising shot towards the roof of the net after his wonderful solo run, but Sam Johnstone thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
45+2' 0:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
42' Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
40' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

40' Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
38' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
37' Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
35' Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
33' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar.
32' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
30' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
28' Willy Boly (Nottingham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Roy Hodgson is forced to make a change. Jeffrey Schlupp is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace).
25' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
23' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
21' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
20' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
19' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
16' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) hits a long-range volley without any hesitation towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows good anticipation and makes a save.
15' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

15' A lofted cross from Serge Aurier (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nottingham.

13' Crystal Palace slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
12' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
7' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off the line to clear the ball away.
4' Willy Boly (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Craig Pawson will supervise the game today.
